title: Q2 Publication Evidence Freeze and Claim Lock

locked_interpretation.development_confirmation: The full reliability-conditioned method improves MPJPE and PA-MPJPE over the observed-only detector baseline on the matched post-selection development evaluation, with paired hierarchical-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals above zero.
locked_interpretation.official_confirmation: On locked Official TS1-TS6 RGB-detector input, point estimates improve for both primary errors and for both detectors, but the paired 95% confidence intervals include zero; this is external trend evidence, not confirmatory superiority.
locked_interpretation.virtual_view_attribution: The conditional virtual-view increment above reliability-only is positive in point estimates but not statistically resolved. Strong virtual-view synergy is not claimed.
locked_interpretation.publication_position: Q2 cautious study of reliability-conditioned virtual-view fusion under detector and subject shift, emphasizing locked evaluation, robustness boundaries, and transparent negative evidence.

allowed_actions: verify source hashes and evidence contracts
reformat locked metrics into paper tables
compute descriptive macro summaries from locked CSV rows
render figures from locked point estimates and locked confidence intervals
write claim, limitation, and extension registries
forbidden_actions: run model or detector inference on Official TS1-TS6
change a checkpoint, arm, detector, metric, cohort, or aggregation rule
re-bootstrap Official TS1-TS6 with a different seed or hierarchy
select favorable subjects, activities, frames, detectors, or seeds
describe Official TS1-TS6 superiority as statistically confirmed
claim state of the art without a separately audited protocol-matched literature table
primary_reporting_order: factorial attribution of reliability and conditional virtual view
detector, subject, and activity descriptive breakdown

q1_extension_isolation.preferred_next_evidence: independent-dataset confirmation with a pre-registered protocol and frozen Phase9C design
candidate_datasets: HumanEva-I for a smaller feasibility confirmation
Human3.6M for a larger standard-protocol extension
